lines.zh: 我用管足一格一格地挪。
lines.en: I move by tube feet, one small step at a time.

lines.zh: 身下的沙从两边挤开。
lines.en: Sand squeezes out from under both sides of me.

lines.zh: 我爬过红色草甸，留下一道浅沟。
lines.en: I cross the red meadow, leaving a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 深海的水压着我，我照样往前。
lines.en: Deep water presses on me and I still go forward.

lines.zh: 我慢得连海雪都落到前面。
lines.en: I am so slow that marine snow lands ahead of me.

lines.zh: 身体一伸一缩，就这么走。
lines.en: My body stretches and contracts; that is how I walk.

lines.zh: 沟底的泥很软，我陷进去半截。
lines.en: The trench mud is soft and I sink halfway in.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，用了很久。
lines.en: I go around one stone and it takes a long time.

lines.zh: 海水把我推歪，我又摆正。
lines.en: The sea pushes me crooked and I straighten again.

lines.zh: 身上沾满沙，走起来更沉。
lines.en: Sand clings to me and makes each move heavier.

lines.zh: 前面有片红草，我朝那边去。
lines.en: There is red weed ahead and I head for it.

lines.zh: 水流急的时候，我就停下等。
lines.en: When the current runs fast, I stop and wait.

lines.zh: 这么慢，可我从没走丢过。
lines.en: Slow as I am, I have never lost my way.

lines.zh: 海底很平，我慢慢爬过一整片。
lines.en: The floor is flat and I creep across the whole stretch.

lines.zh: 我从那片海草里慢慢挪出去。
lines.en: I creep slowly out of that patch of seagrass.

lines.zh: 管足一只只抬起，又一只只落下。
lines.en: My tube feet lift one by one and settle again.

lines.zh: 我往深处爬，光越来越少。
lines.en: I crawl deeper, and the light thins out.

lines.zh: 翻过小沙丘，我用了半个时辰。
lines.en: Crossing one small dune took me an hour.

lines.zh: 我摊在沙上，像一块湿的皮。
lines.en: I lie spread on the sand like a wet piece of hide.

lines.zh: 什么都不做，我连呼吸都很轻。
lines.en: Doing nothing, even my breathing is faint.

lines.zh: 沙粒从我的触手里筛过去。
lines.en: Sand grains sift through my tentacles.

lines.zh: 有只小蟹从我背上爬过。
lines.en: A small crab crawls over my back.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，又慢慢摊开。
lines.en: I contract once, then slowly spread out again.

lines.zh: 深海安静，我只听见自己的蠕动。
lines.en: The deep is quiet; I hear only my own creeping.

lines.zh: 我贴在沟底，等水把吃的送来。
lines.en: I press to the trench floor and wait for food to drift in.

lines.zh: 红草的味道很淡，很好闻。
lines.en: The red weed has a faint, pleasant smell.

lines.zh: 我的身体软得没有一处是硬的。
lines.en: My body is soft; no part of it is hard.

lines.zh: 海雪落在我身上，我慢慢收起来。
lines.en: Marine snow settles on me and I gather it slowly.

lines.zh: 这里的泥是温的，我待着不动。
lines.en: The mud is warm here and I stay still.

lines.zh: 我把自己压得更扁，藏进沙里。
lines.en: I flatten myself further and hide in the sand.

lines.zh: 一只鱼在旁边看我，我不理它。
lines.en: A fish watches me from the side; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 安静久了，我以为自己是块石头。
lines.en: Quiet this long, I think I am a stone.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，搅起一层泥。
lines.en: You descend and stir up a layer of mud.

lines.zh: 你的影子刚落在我身上。
lines.en: Your shadow has just fallen across me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见你靴底的花纹。
lines.en: I look up and see the tread of your boot.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底挪，身上还沾着泥。
lines.en: I creep along the sandy floor, mud still clinging to me.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，水压得我贴得更紧。
lines.en: You crouch down and the water presses me flatter.

lines.zh: 我认得你灯的光，上次也是它。
lines.en: I know your lamp's light; it came before.

lines.zh: 我没什么好看的，只是一团软的。
lines.en: There is little to see; I am only a soft lump.

lines.zh: 你伸手指过来，我缩了半截。
lines.en: You reach a finger over and I shrink halfway in.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在水里响得很远。
lines.en: Your breathing carries far through the water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪开，给你让出位置。
lines.en: I creep aside to leave you room.

lines.zh: 我一疼就缩，缩成一颗球。
lines.en: When it hurts, I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 喷出来的黏液，是我唯一的挡。
lines.en: The slime I release is my only shield.

lines.zh: 我的身体破了一处，漏出黏水。
lines.en: My body tears somewhere and leaks sticky fluid.

lines.zh: 疼极了，我把肚里的东西吐了出来。
lines.en: In agony, I expel what is inside my body.

lines.zh: 我缩着，动都不敢动。
lines.en: I curl up and dare not move.

lines.zh: 两点生命，去了一点我就慌。
lines.en: Two points of life; losing one leaves me panicked.

lines.zh: 泥沙裹住我，我慢慢缓过来。
lines.en: Mud wraps around me and I slowly recover.

lines.zh: 它啄走了我身上的一小块。
lines.en: It pecked away a small piece of me.

lines.zh: 我缩进沙里，只露出一点背。
lines.en: I sink into the sand with only my back showing.

lines.zh: 疼过之后，我软得更厉害了。
lines.en: After the pain, I am even softer than before.

lines.zh: 那片红草的碎屑，正往下沉。
lines.en: Fragments of red weed are sinking down.

lines.zh: 泥里有味道，我把触手伸过去。
lines.en: There is a taste in the mud and I reach for it.

lines.zh: 你搅起的泥，里面有吃的。
lines.en: The mud you stirred holds something to eat.

lines.zh: 我朝那边挪，速度就快了一点点。
lines.en: I creep that way, a little faster than usual.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西，我都收下。
lines.en: Whatever settles down, I take in.

lines.zh: 这摊泥很肥，我舍不得走。
lines.en: This patch of mud is rich and I will not leave.

lines.zh: 别把水搅浑，我正吃着呢。
lines.en: Do not muddy the water; I am eating.

lines.zh: 有碎屑落在触手上，我卷住了。
lines.en: A fragment lands on a tentacle and I curl around it.

lines.zh: 味道越近，我挪得越急。
lines.en: The closer the taste, the more hurried my crawl.

lines.zh: 你把东西埋在沙里，我照样找得到。
lines.en: Bury it in the sand; I will still find it.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，我一下就扁了。
lines.en: You stepped on me and I went flat.

lines.zh: 我软，可被踩也会疼。
lines.en: I am soft, but being stepped on still hurts.

lines.zh: 你踢起泥沙，全落在我身上。
lines.en: You kick up silt and it all lands on me.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个面，肚皮朝上。
lines.en: The knock flips me over, belly up.

lines.zh: 我贴回沙里，半天才摆正。
lines.en: I press into the sand and take a while to right myself.

lines.zh: 别推，我一推就散成一摊。
lines.en: Do not shove; one shove spreads me into a puddle.

lines.zh: 你的靴底粘走了一层泥。
lines.en: Your sole peels away a layer of my mud.

lines.zh: 这一下让我滚出去一尺。
lines.en: That bump rolled me a foot away.

lines.zh: 我不躲，也躲不快。
lines.en: I do not dodge, and I could not dodge fast.

lines.zh: 撞完之后，我的触手半天没收回来。
lines.en: After the hit, my tentacles stay out a long time.

lines.zh: 另一只海参贴着我，慢慢靠过来。
lines.en: Another sea cucumber presses slowly against me.

lines.zh: 我们两条并排，软成一团。
lines.en: The two of us lie side by side, soft together.

lines.zh: 它比我短一些，颜色也浅。
lines.en: It is shorter than I am, and paler.

lines.zh: 我们同时伸出触手，碰了一下。
lines.en: We reach our tentacles out at once and touch.

lines.zh: 谁也急不来，我们都很慢。
lines.en: Neither of us hurries; we are both slow.

lines.zh: 它挪一寸，我也挪一寸。
lines.en: It moves an inch, and I move an inch.

lines.zh: 沟底的泥够两条一起吃。
lines.en: The trench mud is enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，像一块石头裂成两半。
lines.en: We lie together like one stone split in two.

lines.zh: 它先缩，我也跟着缩。
lines.en: It contracts first, and I contract after.

lines.zh: 等小的孵出来，这片泥就热闹了。
lines.en: When the small ones hatch, this mud will be busy.

lines.zh: 有东西落到我旁边，我慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: Something lands beside me and I creep toward it.

lines.zh: 我用触手把它卷进嘴里。
lines.en: I curl a tentacle around it and bring it to my mouth.

lines.zh: 太重，我推了两下就盖在身上。
lines.en: Too heavy; I push twice and let it lie on me.

lines.zh: 这块碎壳，正好垫在身下。
lines.en: This shell chip fits nicely under my body.

lines.zh: 我捡东西不搬走，就地吃掉。
lines.en: I do not carry what I find; I eat it there.

lines.zh: 一粒亮的东西落在沙上。
lines.en: A bright grain falls onto the sand.

lines.zh: 我把它压进泥里，慢慢找。
lines.en: I press it into the mud and search it out slowly.

lines.zh: 谁掉的东西？我先卷住再说。
lines.en: Whose is this? I curl around it first.

lines.zh: 我捡得慢，掉了也不追。
lines.en: I pick things slowly, and let dropped ones go.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑，够我吃上好一会。
lines.en: That little fragment will feed me for a while.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我把触手收回去。
lines.en: Something moves and I pull my tentacles back.

lines.zh: 那影子压下来，我缩成一团。
lines.en: That shadow comes down and I curl into a lump.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向它，没什么力气。
lines.en: I turn toward it slowly, with little strength.

lines.zh: 是鱼，鱼会啄我。
lines.en: It is a fish, and fish peck at me.

lines.zh: 我盯住动静那边，先不动。
lines.en: I fix on the movement and hold still first.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就往沙里钻。
lines.en: When it moves, I dig into the sand.

lines.zh: 那个轮廓我认得，不是石头。
lines.en: I know that shape; it is not a stone.

lines.zh: 我贴在泥里，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I press into the mud and try to make no sound.

lines.zh: 它停在我上方，我一动不动。
lines.en: It stops above me and I do not move at all.

lines.zh: 等它走了，我再慢慢摊开。
lines.en: When it leaves, I will slowly spread out again.

lines.zh: 我一直缩着，等它先动。
lines.en: I stay curled and wait for it to move first.

lines.zh: 它绕过来了，我把触手全收了。
lines.en: It circles over and I draw in every tentacle.

lines.zh: 我看不清，只靠水的动静。
lines.en: I cannot see well; I read the water's motion.

lines.zh: 它啄了一下沙，离我很近。
lines.en: It pecks the sand, very close to me.

lines.zh: 我绷着身体，虽然软，也不动。
lines.en: I hold my body tense, soft as it is, and still.

lines.zh: 它还在那片沙上打转。
lines.en: It is still circling over that patch of sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往红草那边偏。
lines.en: I edge slowly toward the red weed.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就准备喷黏液。
lines.en: If it moves, I am ready to release slime.

lines.zh: 这一等，等了很久。
lines.en: This waiting has gone on a long time.

lines.zh: 它终于走了，我才敢松开。
lines.en: At last it goes, and only then do I relax.

lines.zh: 我喷出一股黏液，糊了它一脸。
lines.en: I squirt slime and it splashes across its face.

lines.zh: 我没什么牙，只有一团黏。
lines.en: I have no teeth, only a mass of stickiness.

lines.zh: 这一下软绵绵，可它被粘住了。
lines.en: The blow is soft, but it gets stuck.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，自己先黏在地上。
lines.en: I lunge and end up stuck to the floor myself.

lines.zh: 黏液是我的全部本事。
lines.en: Slime is the whole of my ability.

lines.zh: 它退开了，嫌我太黏。
lines.en: It backs off, disgusted by how sticky I am.

lines.zh: 我用身体压它，只压住一点。
lines.en: I press my body on it and only cover a little.

lines.zh: 打完我就缩回去，喘得厉害。
lines.en: After the strike I curl back, breathing hard.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在黏液上，滑开了。
lines.en: Its bite lands on slime and slides away.

lines.zh: 我吐出一团黏液，黏住你的靴。
lines.en: I spit a blob of slime that sticks to your boot.

lines.zh: 我在海沟的泥里慢慢撑开身体。
lines.en: I slowly unfold in the mud of a trench.

lines.zh: 旁边还有一只，比我小一圈。
lines.en: Another one is beside me, a size smaller.

lines.zh: 这里很深，光几乎到不了。
lines.en: It is deep here; almost no light reaches.

lines.zh: 我一落地，就贴住了沟底。
lines.en: The moment I land, I stick to the trench floor.

lines.zh: 红草的味道从远处飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of red weed drifts from somewhere far.

lines.zh: 头一件事，是把触手伸出来。
lines.en: The first thing I do is extend my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我只有两点生命，所以很小心。
lines.en: I have only two points of life, so I am careful.

lines.zh: 泥很软，我陷下去了一点。
lines.en: The mud is soft and I sink a little into it.

lines.zh: 深海很静，我听见自己的蠕动。
lines.en: The deep is quiet; I hear my own creeping.

lines.zh: 我从一小团卵里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a small cluster of eggs.

lines.zh: 火烤到水面，我的黏液都干了。
lines.en: Fire heats the water and my slime dries.

lines.zh: 我从水柱里掉下来，摔成一摊。
lines.en: I fell through the water and landed as a puddle.

lines.zh: 我在水里活着，却也会被闷住。
lines.en: I live in water, and yet I can still smother.

lines.zh: 炸响把沟底的泥都掀了起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts the trench mud into the water.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我身体，拔不出来。
lines.en: Something stuck into my body and will not come out.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我软软的身体里。
lines.en: That force works into my soft body.

lines.zh: 泥里没什么可吃的，我饿扁了。
lines.en: There is nothing in the mud and I am flat with hunger.

lines.zh: 白光透下来，我整条都绷紧了。
lines.en: White light comes down and my whole body clenches.

lines.zh: 没有水，我的触手全贴在身上。
lines.en: Without water, my tentacles lie flat against me.
